text:
luca: Heads up — this morning a prune wave ran for ~12m and blocked the app-of-apps syncs in eu-west, leaving several GPU nodepool CRs in Terminating. We also saw our git backend (S3 proxy) returning 429s under fanout.

maya: wow, saw the alerts but couldn't correlate. which cluster?

luca: eu-west-prod, multiple Argo instances hit at once. logs show repeated 429s and timeouts to our git endpoint. ctx: heavy fanout from app-of-apps.

ian: do we have the argocd server logs? can we see request burst pattern?

luca: pasted a snippet from the argocd-controller: 
```
E[2026-03-18T09:12:05Z] sync failed: Get "https://git-proxy.internal/repos/redwood/configs.git/info/refs": 429 Too Many Requests
E[2026-03-18T09:12:06Z] prune wave stalled: waiting for finalizers on GPUNodePool "gpunode-eu-3" (deleting)
```

hannah: looks like the git-proxy has a rate limiter that wasn't scaled for the fanout. that explains the 429s. any helm hooks stuck as well?

luca: yes a few HelmRelease post-sync jobs got stuck in Pending because the pod images couldn't be pulled (registry throttling) while the controller retried resources. ended up with a cascading deletion hang.

ops-bot: alert: argocd-controller eu-west-prod CPU spike 6x; repo-proxy 429 surge detected; repo-proxy pods restarted automatically by HPA.

maya: short-term mitigation idea: reduce app-of-apps parallelism and disable prune waves temporarily (set --enable-prune=false?) — dangerous but could unblock deletions. Thoughts?

ian: agree on throttling fanout. we can also tweak argocd settings: lower app sync parallelism and add a retry/backoff for git fetch. PR prepared: update argocd-cm to limit syncwaves to 10 concurrent apps.

luca: created a k8s patch to set app-of-apps annotation: `argocd.argoproj.io/sync-wave: "5"` on top-level app to stagger children. applying now.

hannah: also propose increasing repo-proxy replicas and enabling a short token bucket burst window to handle spikes. opening a terraform change to change ASG min=3 -> 5 for repo-proxy.

argocd-bot: deploy triggered: patch applied to app-of-apps, rolling restart of argocd-controller in eu-west-prod queued.

luca: after patch we saw syncs progress again, prune finished for 4/6 stuck CRs, two required manual finalizer removal.

maya: can you share the manual commands you used to clean the remaining ones?

luca: the ones stuck had finalizers from the cloud provider controller. ran: 
```bash
kubectl get gpnodepool.gpu.redwood.io -n infra 
kubectl patch gpnodepool gpunode-eu-3 -n infra -p '{"metadata":{"finalizers":null}}' --type=merge
```
then argocd requeued and deleted the CR properly.

ian: next steps: 
- land terraform to scale repo-proxy ASG + increase registry pull concurrency
- PR to argocd config to set safer default parallelism for app-of-apps
- add circuit-breaker in our git-proxy to return 503 instead of 429 for short bursts so controllers backoff faster

hannah: also add monitoring: track prune duration and count of terminated-but-not-fully-deleted CRs, plus alert when average git-proxy 429s/sec > 5 for 1m.

ops-bot: note: created ticket INFRA-4123 for terraform change, assigned to hana and ian.

luca: thanks all — keeping an eye. will follow up with postmortem. :eyes:
